prompts.name: Attack
prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: Unity uGUI stat icon PNG. Edit the supplied reference strip: isolate and faithfully reproduce ONLY the requested symbol as a standalone flat silhouette on a genuinely transparent background. Preserve the reference symbol's contour and warm ivory color (#FFF8E6). Square canvas, centered symbol, tight framing with only 8% transparent margin each side, fully opaque ivory interior and clean antialiased edges. Intended display size 31 pixels. No card, no letters, no numbers, no separators, no background, no shadow, no glow, no texture, no gradient, no other symbols. The reference is the source of the exact symbol design. Requested symbol: the ATTACK SWORD at the left. Solid ivory broad straight sword angled from bottom-left grip to top-right sharp blade tip at approximately 45 degrees. The tip is a chiseled acute point, the blade is broad with parallel edges and an angular taper. A short diagonal crossguard perpendicular to the blade, narrow handle and a small block pommel. Match the simple filled sword in the attached reference exactly, not an outline sword. The entire sword is one flat ivory shape.

cleanupPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied icon. Keep exactly its symbol shape, orientation, scale and position. CLEAN the image into a flawless FLAT VECTOR-STYLE RASTER ICON. Remove EVERY stray white speckle, particle, fringe and texture outside the intended silhouette and in any transparent gap. Fill the icon with one perfectly uniform opaque warm ivory color #FFF8E6. Edges must be smooth clean geometric antialiased edges, only a one-pixel edge transition, no roughness. Outside the symbol must be perfectly alpha-zero transparent, including all gaps. No black or white background, no noise, no texture, no glow, no shadow, no gradient. Do not add any elements. The output is a standalone production Unity game UI sprite, NOT a textured illustration.
